name: csplit
summary: Split a file at context-defined boundaries.
description: Splits a file into sections at lines matching supplied patterns or line numbers.

options.description: Use PREFIX for output file names.
Use DIGITS digits in output suffixes.

examples.title: Split Markdown sections
examples.explanation: Creates one file for each second-level heading boundary.

examples.title: Split at line numbers
examples.explanation: Splits before the specified line numbers.

examples.title: Discard output details
examples.explanation: Silences byte-count output while splitting at END markers.
